proposal.reason: Main functional change is in GIN-specific networking: GDAKI and PROXY now apply capability-gated LAG TX-port affinity and per-context/peer QP member rotation with fallback/read-back behavior, plus PROXY accepts positive queueDepth requests without resizing. The mlx5 wrapper/symbol and DOCA verbs updates are supporting plumbing for this GIN behavior, not an independent generic-network policy change.
